Name: Fancier Galaxy Sword
Author: DaisyNiko
Description:
Just a simple sprite replacement for the Galaxy Sword.

[b]To Install:[/b]

1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
3. Unzip folder into [code]Stardew Valley\Mods
[/code]4. Run the game with SMAPI

[size=2][i]* This is my first ever mod, so if anyone actually downloads it, please let me know if there are issues or things I need to change. Cheers[/i][/size]

Manifest.Name: Fancier Galaxy Sword
Manifest.Description: Replaces the Galaxy Sword with a flasher, slightly less purple version.
